representative_rule: Within a connected near-duplicate physical-frame component, retain the member with most strict same-month adjacent-year site pairs; break ties by numerically smallest STUDY_ID. Rule uses only source-free physical survey metadata.
unit_of_future_holdout: spatially independent study-network proxy, not row, species, plot or nominal STUDY_ID where physical frame duplicates exist
stages_before_species_response: Verify study geography against a source-independent polygon island/mainland GIS where the literal-island estimand is intended
Verify documented sampling method, event effort comparability, and disjoint survey frame from burned pilot beyond the conservative shared-geography rule
Freeze train-only baseline, CAL-only calibration model, source-proximity reference and C configuration operator without future-response tuning
Freeze study-network/temporal block and min 0->1/0->0 event denominators before any species response access
Only then open species responses for the confirmed eligible subset once; STOP non-estimable systems without subgroup rescue
not_claimed: 33 independently evolved archipelagos or 33 biological populations
33 observed colonization experiments or directional dispersal networks
Measured immigration probability, source-sink rescue or intervention benefit
Prospectively fresh ecological replication; original database already public
Any C-CAL heldout improvement or new biological effect
